# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS

@@ DIRECTED SPELLS
@stat: Ag
@description: The skills in this category provide bonuses to directed spell attacks utilizing the elemental form to which they apply. For example, skill in fire directed spells will give a bonus to all Fire Bolts (regardless of range). Skill may be developed separately for each such spell. A character wishing to develop skill with such a spell must be able to cast it without the need of a spell roll at least once a day, either intrinsically or from an item or runes (i.e., it cannot require overcasting, etc.). The five types of directed spells (with their associated Attack Table) are Fire Bolts (SL 5.4), Ice Bolts (SL 5.5), Lightning Bolts (SL 5.6), Shock Bolts (SL 5.7) and Water Bolts (SL 5.8). See Section 23.7 for guidelines on handling Directed Spell attacks.
